channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — free-for-dev
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Pagehaus — via free-for-dev
item.description: Hosting for plain HTML sites, uploaded over SFTP or in the browser. Free plan: 1 site, 250 MB storage, 20 GB transfer/month, HTTPS on a pagehaus.site subdomain, contact forms, Server Side Includes and cookie-free analytics. No expiry, no card.

item.title: waymorphic.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Vector map tiles (OpenMapTiles schema), MapLibre styles, geocoding and reverse geocoding APIs. No API key, no request limit, fair use policy.

item.title: SignupVet — via free-for-dev
item.description: An API that checks email, phone and IP of new signups. 250 free checks per month, no credit card.

item.title: Enchant — via free-for-dev
item.description: Omnichannel customer communication platform. Free tier includes chat widgets, email newsletters, link-in-bio hub & more.

item.title: BylineCV — via free-for-dev
item.description: Form-based CV and cover letter builder to pass ATS filters and organize all your versions in one place. Free forever for core CV building, exports, and storage, with daily AI limits.

item.title: opengeocoding.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data. Self-host it or use the hosted API. Fifty thousand free queries/month.

item.title: cors.dev — via free-for-dev
item.description: CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with https://proxy.cors.dev/. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.

item.title: OpenUptime — via free-for-dev
item.description: Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.

item.title: MergeMe — via free-for-dev
item.description: MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.

item.title: Dynamic Document API — via free-for-dev
item.description: Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.

item.title: DMARCmetric — via free-for-dev
item.description: DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.

item.title: Monitorable — via free-for-dev
item.description: Server health monitoring for Linux (bare metal, VMs, LXC): host and Docker metrics, systemd services and SMART disk health, with alerting, OpenTelemetry Collector agent. Free for 3 servers, no card required.

item.title: Frontegg — via free-for-dev
item.description: Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs

item.title: The Vibe Hosting — via free-for-dev
item.description: Frictionless vibe hosting for coding agents. One curl gets your agent a root Linux box on an HTTPS subdomain within seconds. Free tier: 2-core, 512 MB server 24/7 with a verified phone, no credit card.

item.title: App AI Gateway — via free-for-dev
item.description: Gateway/proxy for calling AI providers from iOS applications without shipping provider keys or building your own backend. Only allows requests from your real app via App Attest, with rate limits and budgets per user and per app. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per month, no card required.

item.title: Pin Feed — via free-for-dev
item.description: Pin Feed is a website feedback tool to comment on live client website. Free for up to 3 projects with 500 MB storage. Clients can leave feedback without an account.

item.title: UI Verify — via free-for-dev
item.description: Visual regression testing for Storybook, Playwright and Vitest, built for coding agents. 10,000 snapshots per month free, no credit card. 50,000 per month for open-source projects.

item.title: Staxa — via free-for-dev
item.description: Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.

item.title: ROIC.ai — via free-for-dev
item.description: Financial Data API: income statements, balance sheets and cash flows, and earnings call transcripts (with audio and slides) for 68k+ companies. Free tier: 5 requests/minute, 2 years of history, no credit card.

item.title: Flagpool — via free-for-dev
item.description: Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.

item.title: SubdomainWatch — via free-for-dev
item.description: Attack surface monitoring and CI/CD takeover guard. Free standalone DNS scanner, GitHub Action with SARIF export, and continuous asset monitoring tier.

item.title: Jsonpage — via free-for-dev
item.description: Company data API for France and 13 other countries (SIREN, SIRET, VAT check). Free plan: 1,000 requests per day, no credit card.

item.title: ntail.io — via free-for-dev
item.description: Serverless Apache Kafka streaming service. The free plan includes 200 KiB/s in, 400 KiB/s out, 1-day retention and up to 10 topics. No card required and no time limit.

item.title: localscreenshot — via free-for-dev
item.description: Screenshot API that turns any public page into an image or a PDF, from 227 countries, with cookie banners, ads and chat widgets hidden. Also runs as an MCP server, so AI agents take screenshots on their own. Free plan includes 50 screenshots every month, no card required.

item.title: Relvato — via free-for-dev
item.description: Continuous website monitoring - Relvato rechecks all your site vitals (performance, critical user journeys, visual design, security, SEO, legal compliance, accessibility etc) after every code update. Free for one site, no card needed. MCP also available.

item.title: HeyDeer — via free-for-dev
item.description: AI code review for GitHub pull requests. Free plan includes 1,000 credits in the first month and 300 credits monthly after that, including private repositories. Public repository reviews are free within fair-use limits. No credit card required.

item.title: imgduck.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Minimalist and fast image hosting service with direct link and API support. Free tier offers 1GB storage and unlimited requests per month

item.title: AgileHero — via free-for-dev
item.description: All-in-one project management tool. Free plan includes kanban board, backlog, epics, estimation poker, MCP server, REST API and webhooks for 2 users.

item.title: IP99 — via free-for-dev
item.description: IP risk and geolocation API with passive DNS and certificate transparency. Free without a key: 500 IP lookups/day; 10 domain/cert trial lookups/day.

item.title: disban.io — via free-for-dev
item.description: Protect user signups from disposable emails, or just validate an email against disposable service. Free 2000 check credits per month, No Credit Card required.

item.title: StarDesk — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free remote desktop for work and gaming with 4K HDR/144fps streaming across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.

item.title: Network Data Labs — via free-for-dev
item.description: An IP geolocation API with accuracy radius and confidence level, ASN, and Tor, known VPN, privacy relay and hosting signals. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per day.

item.title: Orshot — via free-for-dev
item.description: Automate Videos, PDFs and Images from templates via API, n8n, Zapier and AI Agents. Design templates in a visual editor (or import from Canva or Figma), then automate bulk generation from your data source. The free plan includes 100 render credits every month.

item.title: Splainly — via free-for-dev
item.description: Create product explainer videos for sales and marketing needs. Videos are free to create and can be downloaded or remain hosted on Splainly. A small watermark will be applied and can be removed with a $5 purchase.

item.title: Formgong — via free-for-dev
item.description: Multilingual form backend for generated websites that need contact or other forms. Free tier: 300 submissions/month, email and Telegram notifications.

item.title: Dexio — via free-for-dev
item.description: Shared wiki that all your AI agents read and write, so each one starts with the same context and you can see what they know. Unlimited pages and agents, free for one user.

item.title: velixir — via free-for-dev
item.description: EU-hosted PaaS that builds web apps from source in any language (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, Elixir, Rust, .NET and more), no Dockerfile needed. The free tier includes one app (0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM) that sleeps when idle, custom domains with TLS, and no credit card.

item.title: VPS Snaps — via free-for-dev
item.description: Automated server backups and snapshots across 8 cloud providers, stored in your own bucket or Google Drive. Free plan: 1 server, daily backups, no credit card.

item.title: Pharos — via free-for-dev
item.description: Transactional email API and SMTP relay service for developers. 3,000 emails a month free.

item.title: DomainCanary — via free-for-dev
item.description: DMARC enforcement service that protects your domain from email spoofing. First domain is free with 90 days of report detail and step-by-step policies you publish yourself.

item.title: Cabin — via free-for-dev
item.description: Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics with per-page carbon estimates and an MCP server for AI assistants. Free plan: 1 site, 10k pageviews/month.

item.title: stateofpixel — via free-for-dev
item.description: Catch UI regressions before they merge. Your CI takes the screenshots with Playwright, Storybook or any tool that writes PNGs, and a person approves each change on the pull request. Open source and self-hostable. Free up to 10 GB.

item.title: Everframe — via free-for-dev
item.description: Everframe is bug tracking, crash collection tool with AI triage, reporter conversations and boards all in one platform - for mobile, web, TV and Roku apps. Free tier includes 1000 monthly active installs with unlimited bug and crash reports, unlimited apps and seats, every SDK and AI triage on 50 reports per month.

item.title: Vinktar — via free-for-dev
item.description: Error tracking and product analytics in one tool, set up and queried by your coding agent over MCP. Free for 1M events and 50k errors per month, no card required.

item.title: Sharry — via free-for-dev
item.description: Screen sharing via the browser, no downloads, no installs. Useful for pair programming, presentations or remote support. Free tier: no account, 5-minute sessions, 1 viewer.

item.title: Neon — via free-for-dev
item.description: Managed Postgres, 0.5 GB of storage per project, 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU, scales to zero after 5 minutes. Includes S3-compatible Object Storage with 5 GB per project that branches with the database. 5 GB of network transfer per project, shared across all products.

item.title: tomosu.ai — via free-for-dev
item.description: Scores a repository or pull request with a 0-100 Production Reliability Index, plus fix suggestions and a merge verdict. Free for one repository (public or private) through the VS Code/Cursor plugin, web scan, and GitHub App PR comments.

item.title: onomeo — via free-for-dev
item.description: Onomeo gives you one key for dozens of AI models. Plug it right into tools like Cline, SillyTavern, or Open WebUI using standard OpenAI format. 35 models are completely free (60 requests / 5 hrs per user, pooled at 450 / 5 hrs across all users). Daily check-in credits let you use big models like Claude and GPT, up to a daily limit. Extra credits start at $5/month. We’re in open beta, so expect occasional instability. It’s great for casual use, but not ready to be a daily driver. Feedback is always welcome.

item.title: TeamSort — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free tool to vote on a shared list and rank items together. Create a ranked-choice poll in seconds - no signup.

item.title: Ironfang Render — via free-for-dev
item.description: UK-based screenshot, PDF, image, QR code and clip rendering API with reusable templates and signed URLs. 250 free renders a month with no payment details needed to get started.
